Messages.Body:
I heard something about this card. Was it erratad ?
You'll not have to equip with it before the combat, you can put it on the

Snoop

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Snoop wrote:
> I heard something about this card. Was it erratad ?

Only the "who controls it?" part:

Shackles of Enkindu [DS] - Equipment (Gan) (2)

* Is controlled by the Methuselah who controls the vampire who used
it;
changing the controller of the vampire changes who controls the
Shackles. (errata) [RTR 960708]

> You'll not have to equip with it before the combat, you can put it on the
> other minions like an out-of-turn... Possible ?

No. You still have to equip it before you can use it.
